info.title: SleepTrack API
info.description:
SleepTrack records sleep sessions and turns them into analytics, insights and weekly reports.

**Authentication.** Obtain an access token from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or `register`/`demo`)
and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens live for 15 minutes; the rotating
refresh token is delivered as the `st_refresh` HttpOnly cookie and exchanged at
`POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` together with the `X-CSRF-Token` header (double-submit of `st_csrf`).

**Errors** use [RFC 9457 problem details](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457)
(`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` field.

post.description: Creates the account, signs it in and sends a verification email.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
post.description: Requires the `st_refresh` cookie and an `X-CSRF-Token` header equal to `st_csrf`.

Creates a throw-away account pre-filled with ~90 nights of realistic data.
Demo accounts are deleted automatically after 24 hours.
Always returns 202 so the response never reveals whether an account exists.

post.summary: Set a new password using a reset token
post.description: Signs out every device once the password has been changed.

get.description: Redirects to the provider with PKCE (S256) and a state bound to a cookie.

Signs the user in and redirects to `${FRONTEND_URL}/auth/callback?next=...`,
or to `...?error=<code>` on failure.

delete.summary: Delete the account and all data
delete.description: Requires `confirm: "DELETE"` and, for accounts with a password, the password.

post.description:
Signs out all other devices. Accounts created with OAuth can set a first
password with `current_password: null`.

Timestamps are ISO 8601 (naive values use your timezone); `tags` are separated
by `;` and created when missing. Overlapping or invalid rows are reported and skipped.

post.description:
Rules: 10 minutes to 20 hours long, not in the future, and no overlap with
another session (409 `session_overlap`).
Ids that don't exist or belong to someone else are ignored.
Names are unique per user, case-insensitively (409 `conflict`).

delete.description: Removes the tag from every session that used it.

get.description: Defaults (8 h, 23:00-07:00, ±30 min) apply until goals are saved.

put.description: Also re-scores every stored session against the new goals.

get.summary: Headline metrics for a date range
get.description:
Defaults to the last 30 days. Bedtime and wake averages are circular means;
`previous_period` covers the same number of days immediately before.

get.summary: One entry per day in the range
How each tag relates to quality and duration
Histograms of duration, quality and bedtime hour

get.description: Based on mid-sleep on free (Friday/Saturday) nights versus work nights.

get.summary: Personalised insights for a date range
get.description: Sorted by priority (highest first). Defaults to the last 30 days.
